notes.title: Update notes for version 3.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you too everyone for all of the support and feedback! We've just put out version 3.0.1 with a few bug fixes and tweaks.

We've also begun working on localization support - everything is in place for it now, we just need to actually localize the resources into different languages.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added support for other languages (as soon as localized versions of the strings-en.json file are added, the Language option will show up in the settings)
[*] Updated item names to match action names (which also made the inventory order match the pod action order) - Submitted by Abzan_Sam
[*] Added intro messages to help new players out - Submitted by AceofHearts and Winter
[*] Added missing right-click help options to the oxygen, hull integrity, and repair bots status controls
[*] Removed unused localization strings
[*] Added notifications for when items have been depleted
[*] Changed Top 100 leaderboard to Keep Best instead of always updating your score
[/list]
